newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IPC Information raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IPC Information raised.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said it upgraded IPC Information Systems to a "trading buy" from neutral.
-- said IPC is an attractive takeover candidate.

-- said the recent weakness in the company's cable and wiring business follows previous weaknesses in other divisions. These weaknesses may have caused the majority owners, the Kleinknecht family, to reevaluate the business.
-- set a price target of $20 a share.
-- said there is little downside risk at the current valuation.
